proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1577 indradhanuṣ explicitly means rainbow and gives Pali indradhanu and Prakrit iṁdadhaṇu/iṁdahaṇu. Selected indra/indar/indor/id ar-type plus dhanu(s) forms preserve the recognizable whole compound with regional vowel, rhotic and aspiration variation. These are links to the attested rainbow compound, with learned or regional Indo-Aryan transmission unresolved. Exact response: indor dʰonu.
